description: Claude Mythos found new flaws in HAWK and reduced AES, proving AI can autonomously advance cryptography research. author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Broadcom patched a critical VMware ESXi VM escape flaw (CVE-2026-47876) that could let attackers run code on the host from a compromised virtual machine. The most severe, tracked as CVE-2026-47876 (CVSSv3 base score of 9.3), is a […]
title: Broadcom Patches Critical VMware ESXi Vulnerability Enabling Host Code Execution
